title: Wholegrain Mustard Dressing
description: A simple tangy dressing of wholegrain mustard, cider vinegar, garlic and parsley for salads or roasted vegetables.
steps: Mix all ingredients in a small bowl; season to taste.
notes: Pairs with the English Garden Bounty Bowl (p.139). Use as a salad dressing or drizzle over roasted vegetables.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
